# glinet_firewall_rule (Resource)

Manage one firewall rule by its unique `name` option. Stock rules can be imported by name; new rules are created as named sections. `position` requests an absolute UCI rule index.

## Import existing configuration

Use an initialized project from [Check the router](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/elephant-evergreen/glinet/latest/docs#check-the-router). Add this import block with your resource address and the existing object’s ID.

```terraform
import {
  to = glinet_firewall_rule.guest_dns
  id = "Allow-Guest-DNS"
}
```

1. Add the example’s resource block with the values already on the router.
2. Run `terraform plan -out=adopt.tfplan`. For one import, expect `1 to import, 0 to add, 0 to change, 0 to destroy`. If the plan proposes changes, match the differing arguments to the router and save a new plan.
3. Run `terraform apply adopt.tfplan` once the saved plan contains only the import. The next `terraform plan` should report `No changes`.

If you are unsure what values to use, [generate a draft from the existing object](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import/generating-configuration). Keep the import block, omit the resource block, and run `terraform plan -generate-config-out=generated.tf`. Review the draft before preparing the saved import plan.

## Example configuration

```terraform
resource "glinet_firewall_rule" "guest_dns" {
  name       = "Allow-Guest-DNS"
  src        = "guest"
  protocols  = ["tcp", "udp"]
  dest_ports = ["53"]
  target     = "ACCEPT"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Unique rule name.

### Optional

- `delete_behavior` (String) Destroy behavior. `forget` releases Terraform ownership and preserves the UCI section; `delete` removes a Terraform-created named section. Firmware-owned anonymous sections are always preserved.
- `dest` (String) Destination zone, `*`, or empty.
- `dest_ips` (Set of String) Destination addresses or CIDRs.
- `dest_ports` (Set of String) Destination ports or ranges.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the rule is active.
- `family` (String) Address family: `ipv4`, `ipv6`, or `any`.
- `position` (Number) Absolute UCI firewall rule index. Zero leaves ordering unspecified.
- `protocols` (Set of String) Protocols, such as `tcp`, `udp`, `icmp`, or `all`.
- `src` (String) Source zone, `*`, or empty.
- `src_ips` (Set of String) Source addresses or CIDRs.
- `src_ports` (Set of String) Source ports or ranges.
- `target` (String) Target: ACCEPT, REJECT, DROP, or LOG.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Stable import identifier.
- `uci_section` (String) Resolved UCI section name on the router.
